prompts.rest: Use case: precise-object-edit. Replace the provided thin dangling arm sprite with a premium detailed chunky potato arm for the same avatar system. No wound, clothing, nails, separate segments, detached fingers, extra fingers, frame or external cast shadow. Keep whole arm fully inside canvas with spacious margins.

prompts.stubble: Use case: production transparent sprite. Create ONLY scattered very short dark brown beard stubble hairs arranged in a soft broad U-shaped chin zone, on genuine alpha transparency. Premium detailed 3D potato avatar style, warm upper-left studio light. The beard area is about 620 pixels wide and 210 pixels tall, centered in a 1024 square with generous empty margins. Sparse separate tapered tiny hair strokes, most of the area must remain completely transparent BETWEEN the hairs. Natural patchy density fading to zero at both the outer and inner edges. prompts.scarf: Create a replacement SCARF sprite for a premium detailed 3D potato avatar. Reference 1 is the flawed narrow human-neck scarf to completely redesign. Reference 2 is the potato body this must wrap around, provided only for proportions and matching warm upper-left studio illumination. OUTPUT ONLY THE SCARF, absolutely no potato/body/face/arms, on true transparent background. Square 1024x1024 canvas. This is NOT a closed oval neck opening: a potato has no neck. Render the FRONT VISIBLE HALF of a generously wide red knitted winter scarf wrapped snugly around a broad rounded potato torso just below its face. A continuous broad gently bowed horizontal band spans x=225 to x=800, y=570 to y=680, its top edge gently dipping in center. At both outer ends the fabric curves away and disappears behind the imagined body; no exposed hollow back loop, no freestanding ring. The band should have visibly curved cylindrical form, strong natural cloth tension, rich individual wool fibers, knitted stitches, compressed folds, subtle soft self shadows, left highlights and right shading. One believable tucked knot at viewer right around x=665 y=645 and two softly hanging tails to y=835, one shorter, resting against the imagined body, gravity-correct. Professional stylized realism, fine textile detail, sumptuous tactile materials. Entire scarf inside those coordinates with completely empty transparent area elsewhere. No external cast shadow outside the fabric, no text, no frame, no other object.

normalization: Preserve RGBA; proportional downscale into 1024 px shared canvases; alpha-threshold bounds and SHA-256 recorded in assets/manifest.json. The same rest-arm artwork serves both sides; the compositor mirrors the holding-side copy.
notes: Scarf prompt requested a broad red knitted front-only wrap, upper-left light, true transparency, turned-away side edges, a right-side knot and gravity-correct tails. Bowtie and tie received a follow-up background-extraction instruction to retain fabric and remove all pixels outside its silhouette; alpha inspection confirmed the visible RGB aura was fully transparent.

rejected.smirk: A replacement smirk repeated the thick-lip shape, so it was not shipped; the existing mouth is integrated with a softer skin mask instead.
rejected.lanyard_first: The first broad lanyard still had an oversized badge; shortening the straps made it look like a belt on Round bodies. Replaced by a shallower source with a smaller badge.
